try { work(); } catch (error) { throw error; }
try { work(); } catch (error) { throw error; } finally { cleanup(); }
try { work(); } catch (error: unknown) { /* comment */ throw ((error as Error)!); unreachable(); }
try { work(); } catch (error) { log(error); throw error; }
try { work(); } catch ({ error }) { throw error; }
try { work(); } catch { throw another; }
